A different kind of airline

✳

Big adventures.
One little fold.

We believe the best journeys start with a little curiosity and a blank sheet of paper. Origami Airlines is an imaginary airline celebrating the art of going nowhere in particular.

No queues, no baggage fees, no middle seats. Just you, a paper plane, and an open sky.
